# Agentic Systems Studio | HTF

- [API Contract Workbench | HTF](https://howthtechnologyfactory.pro/products/api-contract-workbench-jetbrains.html): JetBrains API contract review and repeatable checks. Developed but not submitted Planned $35 per user per year. Status: Developed but not submitted.

> Focused tools for people and teams. Released APIs and MCP tools run on Apify; Each product uses one of four explicit release statuses: Coming Soon - in development; Developed but not submitted; Submitted and in Review; Available for Purchase. Each product page states its platform and release status.
